title: Berry-Heisenberg Random Waves
summary: We construct a new family of random fields on the Heisenberg group $\mathbb{H}$, the sub-Riemannian analog of $\mathbb{R}^{n}$. These fields are generalized random eigenfunctions of the sub-Laplacian on $\mathbb{H}$, and can be viewed as the sub-Riemannian counterpart to the Berry random wave model in $\mathbb{R}^{n}$. The construction of such waves relies on the representation theory of $\mathbb{H}$, and differs from the Euclidean case because of the presence of infinite-dimensional unitary irreducible representations.
